The after-merge spot-check of #3367 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42376382383)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`765489f9534d`). `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3367 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/InspectSheet.tsx`: Five of the inspect overlay's modal sheets (InspectSheet, CardListSheet, FaceDownSheet, StackSheet, HeroInspect) still close by a text "Close" button. The issue's acceptance item says every dialog's close is the same ✕ at the top right, and the only reason the ruling gives ("not on issue #3221's list") does not explain why they cannot take it.
  Evidence: Issue #3221: "A dialog whose shape really differs (the inspect overlay, …) may keep its own body, but it takes the shared scrim, layer, close control and keys hook. If one cannot, list it in the ruling with the reason." Acceptance: "Every dialog's close control is the same ✕ glyph (or icon), top right." spec/rulings/R3221000.md, Exceptions: "Its other sheets (a card's touch sheet, a pile's list, a face-down card, the stack and hero inspect) keep their text Close: they were not on issue #3221's list." The diff gave these five files `modal.layerProps` (InspectSheet.tsx:39, CardList.tsx:306, FaceDown.tsx:93, StackSheet.tsx:66) but kept their text Close. CardDetail.tsx shows the fix: `<DialogClose buttonRef={closeButton} testid={INSPECT_CLOSE} {...modal.dismissProps} />`. The INSPECT_CLOSE / hero-inspect-close testids must stay, since stack-wheel-and-sweeps.cy.tsx:23 and emotes-layout.cy.tsx:280 use them. dialogs.test.ts does not catch this: it only looks for the ✕ and × glyphs, not text "Close" buttons. Once fixed, the exception in R3221000 should go.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
